notes.title: Patch Notes 1.3
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed a problem where the monster inside the factory couldn't hit the player on certain angles.
[*] Lockers now can be opened from a closer distance than before.
[*] Player now receives input from the playable character to make it further clear on what to do while being chased by the first spider creature.
[*] Text of the game is improved.
[*] Vsync is fixed. Now it should work as intended.
[/list]

tags.bug: Fixed a problem where the monster inside the factory couldn't hit the player on certain angles.
Vsync is fixed. Now it should work as intended.

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.2
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed the problem of player getting stuck in some parts of the factory.
[*] Improved AI behavior of the monster inside the factory.
[*] Spider creatures now always turn to player while attacking.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.1
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Fixed the bug where the hand icon (interact icon) doesn't go away after picking up the electric cable.
[*]Fixed the problem of player getting stuck in some parts of the environment.
[*]Text of the game is improved.
[*]Spider creatures now have better death animation if they follow up each other to death.
[*]Fixed the problem of spider creatures walking on unwanted objects.
[/list]
